∀ (F : (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State → Bool) → Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Limits → Nat → Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State → Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Outcome × Nat), (∀ (policy : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State → Bool) (limits : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Limits) (state : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State), F policy limits 0 state = (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.runBounded limits 0 state, 0)) → (∀ (policy : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State → Bool) (limits : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Limits) (ticks : Nat) (state : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State), F policy limits (ticks + 1) state = match state.control with | Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Control.complete value => (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.runBounded limits 0 state, ticks + 1) | Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Control.refused reason => (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.runBounded limits 0 state, ticks + 1) | Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Control.blackhole address => (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.runBounded limits 0 state, ticks + 1) | Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Control.yielded plan => (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.runBounded limits 0 state, ticks + 1) | x => if (!policy state) = Bool.true then (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Outcome.suspended Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Suspension.capacity state, ticks + 1) else match Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.runBounded limits 1 state with | Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Outcome.suspended Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Suspension.ticks next => F policy limits ticks next | other => (other, ticks)) → F = Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachineFast.forceWithFast

∀ (limits : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Limits) (ticks : Nat) (state : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State), Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachineFast.runFrom limits ticks state state.stack.length = Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.runBounded limits ticks state

∀ (limits : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Limits) (state : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State), Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachineFast.stopped state.control = Bool.false → Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.step limits state = if (Decidable.decide ((Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.stepRaw state).heap.size ≤ limits.heap) && Decidable.decide ((Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.stepRaw state).stack.length ≤ limits.stack)) = Bool.true then Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Outcome.suspended Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Suspension.ticks (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.stepRaw state) else Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Outcome.suspended Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Suspension.capacity state
